name: LocalTunnel Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed LocalTunnel client and server for exposing local HTTP services through a public URL; self-hosted deployment has no software-imposed session or traffic quota.
watch_out: Self-hosted server requires your own public host, wildcard DNS, reverse proxy and TLS setup; hosting and bandwidth are not free. The public localtunnel.me relay is best-effort with ephemeral URLs and no guaranteed uptime or fixed subdomain.
